manifest.label: feasible-component-grasp-v1
manifest.policy: Geometry-only three-axis component bank with two base offsets and two IK seeds; common control from box development. All original objects and source rows retained. Square uses explicitly alternative contact profile because original passive reset violates contact-depth admission; Threading retains original model.

report.gripper_admission_scope: Static sampled robot aperture envelopes; actual gripper tracking and all contacts remain independently physics-gated
report.object_collision_scope: Source reset object stays unchanged; static admission checks environment and robot self only
report.scope: Robot base and right-arm joint configuration only; no source or scene changes
